yapping

Welcome to yapping

Three things and you're talking instead of typing.

01

Hold Ctrl + Win and talk

Anywhere your cursor blinks. Release and the words appear. A quick tap does nothing; Esc while holding cancels.

02

Let the microphone through

If nothing transcribes, check Windows Settings > Privacy & security > Microphone, and allow desktop apps to access it.

03

The speech model downloads once

Dictation

Cleanup

Polish transcripts with a local model. Raw words always win if a cleanup looks wrong. Off by default; everything stays on your machine either way.

Per-app styles

Cleanup writes differently per app: terse prompts for AI chats, casual for Slack, verbatim in terminals. A style applies when the focused app's process name matches at the moment you start talking.

Last 50 dictations

Raw and cleaned side by side, stored only on this PC. Audio is never saved.

Listen to system audio

Transcribes whatever your PC is playing: lectures, podcasts, the other side of a call. Text lands every few seconds. Nothing is recorded to disk.

Transcribe a file

Audio or video: wav, mp3, m4a, mp4, flac, ogg, and friends. Long files are processed in chunks; everything stays local.

Updates

Checks GitHub only when you click. No background phoning home.
